verdict.rationale: Formant's ReadMe-hosted API reference ships a live "Try It!" console on each endpoint page, with multi-language code snippets and a bearer-JWT credential field, so examples are interactive and runnable. Per-endpoint OpenAPI definitions back the reference. The runner only executes against production api.formant.io, which limits safe exploration. Missing for 10: a sandbox/test environment for the runner, independent or hands-on corroboration of the console.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The ReadMe reference ships the live "Try It!" console per endpoint ("Click Try It! to start a request and see the response here!") with multi-language snippets and a bearer-JWT credential field.
Formant's ReadMe-hosted reference publishes machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.0 definitions per endpoint
